categories.label: Keep data where it may be

controls.title: An inventory of AI in use is kept
controls.statement: Every use of AI, the tools and models behind it, and the data it works with are recorded in one inventory with permanent references.

controls.title: Registering a use is easy
controls.statement: Anyone can look a tool up and register an everyday use in about a minute, so that the governed path is the easy one.

controls.title: Units attest that their list is complete
controls.statement: At least once a year, each unit's steward confirms that the unit's list of AI uses is complete.

controls.title: Governance roles are assigned
controls.statement: Named people hold the governance, review, audit, and steward roles, and the list is reviewed when people move.

controls.title: The use has a named, accountable owner
controls.statement: A named person answers for the use, and a second person can take over.

controls.title: The owner confirms the record on a schedule
controls.statement: The owner confirms, at least once a year, that the record still describes the use.

controls.title: Requests are tiered by published rules
controls.statement: Every request gets a risk tier from rules anyone can read, and the tier decides who reviews and who decides.

controls.title: Automatic approvals are sampled and checked
controls.statement: A sample of the approvals that rules make by themselves is checked by a person, and the share agreed is tracked.

controls.title: Nobody reviews or decides their own request
controls.statement: The system refuses a review, a decision, or a risk acceptance from anyone on the asking side.

controls.title: The approval is reviewed before it ends
controls.statement: The use is reviewed again before its approval period ends, with the earlier answers confirmed or corrected.

controls.title: Performance is validated before use
controls.statement: The tool or model is tested on data like that it will see, and the result is kept, before anyone relies on it.

controls.title: Performance is measured by group
controls.statement: Where people are affected, accuracy is measured for the groups involved and the limits are stated.

controls.title: Only permitted classes of data are used
controls.statement: The data used stays within the classes the tool is approved for, and the owner checks a sample of use.

controls.title: Data is de-identified before the tool sees it
controls.statement: Identifiers are removed before data about people is sent to a tool, and the step is tested.

controls.title: The data's terms cover this use
controls.statement: The consent, agreement, or license the data came under has been checked against this use.

controls.title: A model stays where its training data may be
controls.statement: A model trained on sensitive data is stored and run only where that data may be kept, and is not shared more widely.

controls.title: Retention of inputs and outputs is set
controls.statement: How long prompts and outputs are kept is set in the tool, and confirmed with the supplier where one is involved.

controls.title: A person checks outputs before they are used
controls.statement: A named person checks outputs against the source before they are relied on, and the check is sized to the volume.

controls.title: There is a tested way to stop it
controls.statement: How to stop the system is written down, someone is named who may do it, and it has been tried.

controls.title: People affected are told AI is involved
controls.statement: Those who receive or are affected by the output are told, in plain words, that AI was used.

controls.title: Affected people can ask for a person to look again
controls.statement: Anyone affected by a decision the output informed has a route to a human review, and knows it exists.

controls.title: Agreements with suppliers are on file
controls.statement: Each supplier of an approved tool has an agreement on file with its end date and notice period.

controls.title: The supplier does not train on what is entered
controls.statement: The agreement or the tool's settings forbid training on inputs, and this has been confirmed.

controls.title: The model version is recorded or pinned
controls.statement: The version or checksum of the model in use is recorded, and pinned where the supplier allows.

controls.title: A model file comes from a known source
controls.statement: Weights come from a known source, the checksum is recorded, and the format cannot carry code.

controls.title: Anyone can report an incident
controls.statement: There is one simple way to report an incident or a near miss, people are thanked for using it, and what is learned is shared.

controls.title: Incidents are triaged and closed with lessons
controls.statement: Each report is triaged with a severity, the records involved are linked, and it is closed with its cause and what will change.

controls.title: Exceptions are approved and always end
controls.statement: A departure from a requirement is approved by governance, has something done instead, and ends on a date.

controls.title: The history is verified
controls.statement: The append-only history is verified on a schedule, and the result is kept.

controls.title: Every decision has a recorded reason
controls.statement: Each approval, refusal, and exception carries its reason, who made it, and when.

controls.title: What produced a result is recorded
controls.statement: The model, its version, the prompts, and the settings are recorded with results meant for publication.

controls.title: An AI policy is in force and reviewed on schedule
controls.statement: The organization has a written policy on the use of AI, approved by the people accountable for it, with an owner and a date it is next reviewed.

controls.title: People who use AI have acknowledged the policy
controls.statement: The people the policy applies to are asked to acknowledge it, and who has and has not is recorded.

controls.title: The scope of the program is written down
controls.statement: What the program covers, who has a stake in it, and the organization's part in each kind of AI system (builds it, buys it, or only uses it) are recorded and kept current.

controls.title: The program has objectives and measures against them
controls.statement: The program has stated objectives with targets, and the measures are read against them at set times.

controls.title: Leadership reviews the program on a schedule
controls.statement: Leadership is given a report on the program at set times, considers it, and what it decided is recorded.

controls.title: The program is audited and findings are closed
controls.statement: Someone independent of the program checks at planned intervals that it does what it says, and what they find is tracked until it is closed.

controls.title: Reviewers and decision makers are trained
controls.statement: The people who review and decide requests have current training for that work, and a record of it is kept.

controls.title: An impact assessment is done before approval
controls.statement: Before a use that could seriously affect people is approved, its effects on those people are assessed in writing, and the assessment is kept with the decision.

controls.title: Training data is checked for quality and fitness
controls.statement: Data used to train or tune a model is checked for completeness, accuracy, and fitness for the purpose, and the check is kept.

controls.title: Users are given a tool's terms and known limits
controls.statement: People who use an approved tool are shown what it may be used for, what data it may be given, and what it is known to get wrong.

controls.title: Access, logging, and encryption are shown for tools that hold sensitive data
controls.statement: For a tool approved for Protected or Restricted data, it is shown that access is tied to a verified person, that activity is logged and can be reviewed, that data is protected from improper change, and that it is encrypted when sent and stored.

controls.title: An incident involving personal or health data gets a breach assessment
controls.statement: When an incident may have exposed personal or health information, the likelihood that it was compromised is assessed in writing, and who must be told is decided from that.
